correctness.summary: The K_{3,3} obstruction is proved directly from interval geometry, and the converse is verified by an explicit monochromatic centre-containment representation for every complete multipartite graph with at most one part of size at least three; the one-part case is covered by the stated n_2=0 convention.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Exact and synonymous searches found the 2026 source classification for complete bipartite graphs but no complete multipartite extension or equivalent monochromatic shell construction. The full recent preprint text was not inspected, leaving a stated residual risk.

value.summary: The result exactly extends a class singled out in the introducing paper, proves coincidence of the two new graph classes on all complete multipartite graphs, and reduces membership there to induced K_{3,3}-freeness.

limitations: Complete multipartite graphs only; no general forbidden-subgraph characterization is claimed.
The full Basit-Suter-Zhang preprint theorem text was not inspected; originality remains to the best of our knowledge.
Independent audit has not been performed.
review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.
